facts.fact: Reveil d'Algerie reports the health minister said the national electronic medical record platform was designed and developed by engineers and staff of the ministry's information systems directorate.

Reveil d'Algerie reports the first national rollout training week opened on 26 July 2026 with over 200 trainers from ten pilot wilayas, with extension planned to 69 wilayas and over 2,500 health structures.
